root.label: Justice Department UCLA law admissions discrimination finding

events.label: Justice Department UCLA law admissions discrimination finding

slots.name: Black applicant odds
slots.sentence: In 2025, Black applicants had seven times the odds of being admitted compared to “otherwise equivalent” white applicants, the letter said.

slots.name: Hispanic applicant odds
slots.sentence: Hispanic applicants had two times the odds of getting in that year, the Justice Department said.

slots.name: finding status
slots.sentence: The Justice Department found Thursday that the law school at the University of California, Los Angeles, illegally considered race in admissions.

slots.name: investigated schools count
slots.sentence: The law school is the third named in a Justice Department probe

slots.name: announcement date
slots.sentence: The UCLA School of Law discriminated against white and Asian students in their admissions process, the Department of Justice said on Thursday, Oct. 1.
